details: Searching for zero-copy sharded input CB consumption idiom (cb_descriptor_from_sharded_tensor + cb_wait_front)

Canonical idiom: consumer of a zero-copy sharded input CB must arm the fifo with cb_reserve_back+cb_push_back (NO data read). Two variants: compute self-arms (Python examples reduce_block/sfpu_tile_scope/matmul/row_reduce/compute_block_size/eltwise), or reader NCRISC arms via setup_sharded_buffer helper (deepseek_moe_gate C++). Framework does NOT auto-populate. get_read_ptr-and-skip-wait is NOT used.
Investigating RM sharded L1 layout + cb_descriptor_from_sharded_tensor page format + tilize-on-read patterns for cross-core reduction refinement

cb_descriptor_from_sharded_tensor page_size=buffer aligned_page_size (RM=stick page, TILE=tile page); RM WIDTH shard = contiguous sticks, no tile padding; canonical RM tilize-on-read = compute_block_size _tile_paged_backed_cb overriding page_size to TILE_SIZE + ckl::tilize; rms_norm R4a is the target refinement
Investigating cb_descriptor_from_sharded_tensor, tilize/untilize compute+dataflow helpers, partial-width tilize from RM sticks for RMS-norm kernel

cb_descriptor_from_sharded_tensor page_size=buffer aligned_page_size: RM sharded => (1,shard_w) stick page; TILE => tile page. tilize compute helper always emits block_width_tiles full 32-wide tiles; partial width handled by reader read_sticks_for_tilize padding L1 stride to full tile + pre-zeroing sticks CB + partial reduce scaler. Existing example: rms_norm reader/compute + toy_tilize_untilize.
